config.description: Automation WebSocket endpoint for the 'connect' flow (e.g. ws://localhost:9420). When a local endpoint is not listening and auto-launch is enabled, mp_ensureConnection may start DevTools if it can resolve a project.

config.label: Force 'launch' or 'connect' mode
config.description: Force 'launch' or 'connect' mode. Defaults to 'launch' unless WEAPP_WS_ENDPOINT is set.

config.label: Optional Mini Program project directory used by launch and local auto-launch flows
config.description: Optional Mini Program project directory used by launch and local auto-launch flows. The server can also resolve a persisted default, a recent project, or the current working directory.

config.label: Optional override for the WeChat DevTools CLI binary path (e
config.description: Optional override for the WeChat DevTools CLI binary path (e.g. /Applications/wechatwebdevtools.app/Contents/MacOS/cli on macOS).

config.label: Automation websocket port passed to 'cli auto --auto-port' in launch mode (default 9420)
config.description: Automation websocket port passed to 'cli auto --auto-port' in launch mode (default 9420).

config.label: Milliseconds passed to miniprogram-automator when launching WeChat DevTools
config.description: Milliseconds passed to miniprogram-automator when launching WeChat DevTools.

config.label: Optional account passed to miniprogram-automator launch
config.description: Optional account passed to miniprogram-automator launch.

config.label: Whether launch mode should trust the project
config.description: Whether launch mode should trust the project. Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, or on/off.

config.label: Additional whitespace-separated CLI arguments passed during launch
config.description: Additional whitespace-separated CLI arguments passed during launch.

config.label: Optional working directory passed to the DevTools launch process
config.description: Optional working directory passed to the DevTools launch process.

config.label: Whether to close or disconnect the automator session after each tool call
config.description: Whether to close or disconnect the automator session after each tool call. Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, or on/off.

config.label: Allow mp_ensureConnection to launch local WeChat DevTools with cli auto when the configured local automation port is not listening
config.description: Allow mp_ensureConnection to launch local WeChat DevTools with cli auto when the configured local automation port is not listening. Defaults to enabled; set false to disable.

config.label: Milliseconds to wait for a locally auto-launched automation port (default 45000)
config.description: Milliseconds to wait for a locally auto-launched automation port (default 45000).

config.description: Milliseconds to wait for an automator websocket connection (default 45000).
